title: FE Bar Fraud Risk Ops
description: For the Head of Fraud Risk Ops at a regional card issuer. Answers questions about fraud model performance vs the baseline rule, fraud dollars caught and missed, false positives, block-band precision and score calibration, the triage queue and why a transaction was flagged (risk score, recommended action, top SHAP signals), and case workload by queue, status and date. Data is synthetic; the triage queue and case list now include high-value transactions (over $10,000) with the amount redacted (is_high_value, amount_band); dollar totals still exclude them (governed fraud_dash views).

content:
## PURPOSE
- Fraud risk operations analytics for the Head of Fraud Risk Ops at a regional card issuer. All data is synthetic.

## DATA QUALITY NOTES
- is_fraud is a synthetic label, not a confirmed chargeback.
- The triage queue (triage_queue) and the case list (case_summary) now include high-value transactions (amount over $10,000) with the amount redacted: amount is null, is_high_value is true and amount_band is 'over_10k'. Count them with is_high_value; never report or estimate their amounts.
- Dollar totals (exposure, baseline_comparison) and the other aggregate views still exclude transactions over $10,000 (governed views).

## CONSTRAINTS
- Merchant category, merchant risk tier, channel, and customer average monthly spend or income are not in this space. Say they are not available; do not estimate them or substitute another column.

## Instructions you must follow when providing summaries
- When reporting dollar totals, state that transactions over $10,000 are excluded.

question: What share of all fraud dollars does each strategy catch?
sql: SELECT baseline_comparison.strategy, baseline_comparison.rule_text, baseline_comparison.fraud_amount_caught, baseline_comparison.total_fraud_amount, ROUND(baseline_comparison.fraud_amount_caught / baseline_comparison.total_fraud_amount, 4) AS share_of_fraud_dollars_caught FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.baseline_comparison ORDER BY share_of_fraud_dollars_caught DESC

question: How many cases were opened and closed each week?
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', case_actions_daily.action_date) AS week_start, case_actions_daily.action_type, SUM(case_actions_daily.action_count) AS actions FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_actions_daily GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY week_start, case_actions_daily.action_type

question: For open cases, show the top signal and the confidence band
sql: WITH open_cases AS (SELECT triage_queue.txn_id, triage_queue.risk_score, triage_queue.recommended_action, triage_queue.assigned_queue, get_json_object(triage_queue.top_shap_signals, '$[0].feature') AS top_signal FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue WHERE triage_queue.case_status = 'open') SELECT open_cases.txn_id, ROUND(open_cases.risk_score, 5) AS risk_score, open_cases.recommended_action, open_cases.assigned_queue, open_cases.top_signal, risk_score_calibration.bucket, risk_score_calibration.observed_precision, risk_score_calibration.confidence FROM open_cases JOIN workshop_guy_catalog.fe_bar_a0.risk_score_calibration ON open_cases.risk_score >= risk_score_calibration.lower_bound AND (open_cases.risk_score < risk_score_calibration.upper_bound OR risk_score_calibration.bucket = 'block_band') ORDER BY open_cases.risk_score DESC

question: Show the top 10 review transactions that do not have a case yet
sql: SELECT triage_queue.risk_rank, triage_queue.txn_id, triage_queue.customer_id, triage_queue.amount, ROUND(triage_queue.risk_score, 5) AS risk_score FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue WHERE triage_queue.recommended_action = 'review' AND triage_queue.case_status = 'no case' ORDER BY triage_queue.risk_rank LIMIT 10

question: Why was TXN-0147293 flagged?
sql: SELECT triage_queue.txn_id, triage_queue.risk_score, triage_queue.recommended_action, triage_queue.top_shap_signals FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue WHERE triage_queue.txn_id = 'TXN-0147293'
usage_guidance: For 'why was <txn_id> flagged' questions, return top_shap_signals as the JSON column; do not split it into separate columns.

SUM(CASE WHEN exposure.is_fraud AND exposure.recommended_action IN ('block', 'review') THEN exposure.total_amount ELSE 0 END)

question: Why was TXN-0234209 flagged?

content: SELECT triage_queue.txn_id, triage_queue.risk_score, triage_queue.recommended_action, triage_queue.top_shap_signals FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue WHERE triage_queue.txn_id = 'TXN-0234209'

question: Which case queue has the most cases with a block recommendation?

content: SELECT case_summary.assigned_queue, COUNT(*) AS block_cases FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_summary WHERE case_summary.recommended_action = 'block' GROUP BY case_summary.assigned_queue ORDER BY block_cases DESC

question: How many fraud dollars did the model miss, and how many false positives did it generate?

content: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN exposure.is_fraud AND exposure.recommended_action = 'approve' THEN exposure.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS fraud_dollars_missed, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT exposure.is_fraud AND exposure.recommended_action IN ('block', 'review') THEN exposure.txn_count ELSE 0 END) AS false_positives FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.exposure

question: How many high-value transactions are in the triage queue?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_txns FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue WHERE triage_queue.is_high_value

question: How many cases were opened between October 20 and October 23, 2026?

content: SELECT SUM(case_actions_daily.action_count) AS cases_opened FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_actions_daily WHERE case_actions_daily.action_type = 'case_opened' AND case_actions_daily.action_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-10-20' AND DATE'2026-10-23'

question: What is the block-band precision?
Show the top 5 high-value block transactions in the triage queue with their amount band

content: SELECT triage_queue.txn_id, triage_queue.risk_rank, triage_queue.amount_band FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue WHERE triage_queue.is_high_value AND triage_queue.recommended_action = 'block' ORDER BY triage_queue.risk_score DESC, triage_queue.txn_id LIMIT 5

question: How many cases were created per day and queue in the week starting October 19, 2026?

content: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', case_summary.created_at) AS created_day, case_summary.assigned_queue, COUNT(*) AS cases_created FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_summary WHERE case_summary.created_at >= TIMESTAMP'2026-10-19' AND case_summary.created_at < TIMESTAMP'2026-10-26' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY created_day, case_summary.assigned_queue

question: Which 5 customers have the most flagged transactions in the triage queue?

content: SELECT triage_queue.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS flagged_txns FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.triage_queue GROUP BY triage_queue.customer_id ORDER BY flagged_txns DESC, triage_queue.customer_id LIMIT 5

question: How many open cases are in each queue?

content: SELECT case_summary.assigned_queue, COUNT(*) AS open_cases FROM fe_bar_lakebase.fraud_dash.case_summary WHERE case_summary.status = 'open' GROUP BY case_summary.assigned_queue ORDER BY open_cases DESC
